0.content: Kazuha's closest friend was an unnamed Electro Vision bearer who travelled with him for a time. When Kazuha told him the Musou no Hitotachi was the Shogun's ultimate stroke, seen only in "divine punishment", the friend answered that there must be one who could withstand it: "There will always be those who dare to brave the lightning's glow." When the Vision Hunt Decree came, he challenged the Vision Hunters to a duel before the throne, partly to test himself and partly to show people what courage meant. He lost to Kujou Sara and was struck down by the Shogun. Kazuha stormed Tenshukaku alone, arrived too late, and seized the dying Vision before the Vision Hunters could take it.

1.comment: Kaedehara Kazuha: Beidou and the Crux Fleet
1.content: Beidou befriended the fugitive Kazuha and took him aboard her flagship, the Alcor, at Ritou, telling the crew to look after him. She did not guess at first how well he fought. The sailors admired his swordsmanship and weather sense and stopped prying when he would not talk. He calls her a comrade everyone can trust. He says she saved his life and gave him the courage to return to Inazuma at its worst. She carried him back during the Sakoku Decree, joking that she had "a wanted fugitive on board".

2.comment: Kaedehara Kazuha: The Traveler and Paimon
2.content: At Beidou's ship Kazuha noticed that the Traveler and Paimon gave off the essences of wind, earth and "the stars", and said their meeting was fate. After the Crux Clash semi-final he took the Traveler aside, guessed they wielded several elements without a Vision, and asked to see it. Together they caught the thief of the Masterless Vision. At Tenshukaku he blocked the Shogun's strike on them. In his Story Quest he promised to support their quest to face the gods and find their sibling.

3.comment: Kaedehara Kazuha: The Raiden Shogun and the Musou no Hitotachi
3.content: In 2.1, after the Traveler won a duel before the throne against Signora, the resistance broke through to Tenshukaku as the Shogun tried to cut the Traveler down. Kazuha's friend's Vision flared with Electro, and Kazuha met the Musou no Hitotachi head-on and blocked it, using Anemo and Electro together. He is the first known survivor of the stroke. Soon after, the Shogun revoked the Vision Hunt Decree, the Sakoku Decree and his arrest warrant. Kazuha bears her no personal grudge; he opposed the decree because it robbed people of their hopes.
